'''Splitter''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 transport belt into multiple belts (up to 3).|A transport belt adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 transport belt into multiple belts (up to 3).

The Splitter can split the product flow of 1 transport belt to up to 3 transport belts.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Belt Splitting]]
